scripts.install:frontend: if [ -d 'front-end' ]; then (cd front-end && npm install --no-audit --no-fund); elif [ -d 'frontend' ]; then (cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund); else npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi
scripts.build:frontend: if [ -d 'front-end' ]; then (cd front-end && npm run build) && rm -rf dist && cp -r front-end/dist dist; elif [ -d 'frontend' ]; then (cd frontend && npm run build) && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist dist; else npm run build; fi
